## HollowPlayer

**HollowPlayer** brings the magical abilities and mechanics of Hollow Knight to your Minecraft server. It integrates iconic movement and combat spells, allowing players to unlock powers that transform the way they explore and fight.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7-sBLKaDKTc<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/7-sBLKaDKTc" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

---

## Features

- **Iconic Abilities:** Unlock Abyss Shriek, Shade Soul, Descending Dark, Monarch Wings, and Shade Cloak.
- **Physical Geo System:** Turn mobs into currency with custom Prismarine Crystal Geo.
- **Dynamic Crafting:** Fully customizable recipes for all ability items.
- **Permanent Unlocks:** Right-click crafted items to unlock abilities forever.
- **Immersive Feedback:** Customizable gradient titles, fireworks, and server announcements.
- **World Management:** Whitelist or blacklist specific worlds for plugin features.
- **Full Tab Completion:** Easy access to all administrative commands.

---

## Commands & Permissions

- `/hp` - View the help menu.
- `/hp give <player> <ability>` - Give an ability unlock item.
- `/hp give <player> geo <amount>` - Give physical Geo items.
- `/hp reload` - Reload configuration and crafting recipes.

**Permissions:**
- `hollowplayer.use` (Default: true)
- `hollowplayer.admin` (Default: op)

---

## Configuration

All features are adjustable via `config.yml`, including:
- Ability stats (damage, hunger costs, names)
- Geo drop chances and mob overrides
- Unlock effects (firework types, titles, messages)
- Custom 3x3 crafting recipes

---

## Compatibility

- Supports **Minecraft 1.18 – 1.21.1+**
- Designed for **PaperMC**

---

## Support

- Actively maintained by **HeroicStudios**
- Support available via **Discord**
- Bug reports and suggestions are welcome
